summary.text: David Sutman Jr. is an independent candidate for U.S. Senate in Tennessee who describes himself as a working-class Tennessean and political outsider, and Ballotpedia lists his career experience as a truck driver. He says he is running to focus on cost-of-living issues and government accountability.

paragraphs.text: Ballotpedia lists Sutman's career experience as working as a truck driver.

He describes himself as a working-class Tennessean who was raised with values of hard work, personal responsibility and community, and says he has spent his career "solving real-world problems" and creating opportunities rather than navigating political circles.
